paragraphs: Democracy Live builds remote balloting and elections technology developed for state and local governments.

The Democracy Live Elections Portal is described as a fully accessible remote balloting and elections portal used by over 20 million voters since 2008. The OmniBallot Tablet is an off-the-shelf, HAVA compliant ballot marking device the company says is used in hundreds of polling locations in the United States.

The company says it has been deployed in over 7,000 elections, serving 2,500 jurisdictions. It also reports deployment in 36 states. Democracy Live describes itself as the only elections provider selected and funded by the U.S. Department of Defense and the U.S. State Department. The company lists an office at 2900 NE Blakeley St. in Seattle, Washington. It states a commitment to digital accessibility and conformance with WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

quote.text: Remote, accessible balloting technologies to over 20 million voters since 2008.
